subject: Prepay harmonization matrix + debit memo clarification
messages:
From: Juliette Martin <juliette@brightlane.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: finance_ops@brightlane.com
Date: 2028-06-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: New invoicing layout for committed spend (BrightLane)

Hi David —

Thanks for the demo last week. Finance is ready to move forward with an annual prepay but we have a few internal constraints to reconcile before we sign: PO-numbering across entities, VAT evidence for EU spend, and amortization reporting for our GL.

To keep things moving, can Redwood provide: 
- A single harmonization spreadsheet mapping invoice numbers to the committed-tranche ledger (so our AR team can auto-match)
- A sample debit memo for situations where usage dips below the minimum and a charge needs to be reversed
- Clarification on whether Redwood can issue invoices by legal entity or a single master invoice with sub-ledger lines

We also need the SOW signed and a DocuSign link that ties to the HubSpot deal (so procurement can attach it to the PO).

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement is aiming for invoice issuance in July.

Best,
Juliette Martin
Head of Procurement
BrightLane Corp

Attachment: SOW_BrightLane_v1.pdf (stub)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Juliette Martin <juliette@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New invoicing layout for committed spend (BrightLane)

Juliette —

Thanks, and glad to hear procurement is moving. High level answers below; I'll attach a harmonization matrix and a debit memo template for your AR team to review.

1) Invoicing by default: Redwood issues a single master invoice per billing period that contains line-level detail for each legal entity/region. We can also support separate legal-entity invoices if required by your ERP; there's a small ops fee for multi-entity splits.

2) Invoice numbering: we will populate InvoiceNumber / RelatedPO / LegalEntity columns in the matrix so your AP system can auto-match. We can optionally prefix invoice numbers with your PO if you provide it in advance.

3) VAT and evidence: for EU spend we will attach VAT reverse-charge evidence or local tax forms where applicable; please confirm the billing country per PO so we can select the right VAT flow.

4) Debit memo: attached is a debit memo template we use when true-ups or reversals occur (sample included). Our standard process is to issue a credit and then a correcting invoice; the debit memo is used internally for AR workflows.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll upload the harmonization matrix (prepay_harmonization_matrix.xlsx) and a debit memo template (debit_memo_template_v2.docx) to this thread by EOD tomorrow.
- Kimberly (cc'd) will confirm whether we can route as separate legal-entity invoices under Redwood's existing invoice automation flow.
- If you can send the PO number(s) and preferred invoice remit email, we'll lock the numbering scheme.

Attached: SOW_BrightLane_v1_signed_stub.pdf (we used the exec copy; please confirm if this is the right legal entity)

Cheers,
David Kim
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: prepay_harmonization_matrix.xlsx (stub), debit_memo_template_v2.docx (stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Juliette Martin <juliette@brightlane.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New invoicing layout for committed spend (BrightLane)

Hi Juliette / team —

We reviewed the requested flows with Finance/Ops. A few operational clarifications before we finalize the matrix: 

• Multi-entity billing: we can emit separate invoices per legal entity (option A) OR one master invoice with entity-level line items (option B). Option A requires a secondary accounting mapping step and an ops setup fee of $500 per entity.

• Drawdown tracking: we propose issuing monthly micro-invoices that draw against the prepay bucket. Each micro-invoice will include a custom header field "Commitment-Drawdown-ID" to simplify ledger reconciliation.

• VAT evidence: for EU remit we need the billing country on the PO. If BrightLane prefers us to ship zero-rated invoices (reverse charge) we will include the EC VAT evidence line in the invoice PDF.

• Debit memo flow: sample provided — Redwood will generate a debit memo ID and either issue a correcting invoice or a credit depending on the net movement. The matrix contains examples for: overdraw, underutilization, and multi-entity netting.

I've populated the harmonization sheet with sample rows and a mapping guide. Please review the column "AP_MatchKey" — that is what your system should match against.

Action items for BrightLane:
- Share final PO numbers + billing country per PO
- Confirm preferred invoice split (Option A or B)
- Confirm whether AR wants the Commitment-Drawdown-ID in the PDF header or as a CSV field in the invoice payload (we can do both).

If we get those answers by next Tue (7/3), we can lock numbering and start issuing first micro-invoice on 7/15.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Billing Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: prepay_harmonization_matrix.xlsx (revised stub)

Kimberly / David —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. We reviewed the matrix and have two clarifications: 

1) Commitment-Drawdown-ID placement: AP prefers it as a CSV field in the invoice payload (our ERP can parse that automatically).
2) Invoice split: BrightLane will accept Option B (single master invoice with entity-level line items) to avoid extra PO churn, provided the invoice PDF contains a per-entity subtotal and the AP_MatchKey column is present in the CSV export.

PO numbers and billing country mapping attached (POs_2028_Q3.csv). We also attached our procurement notes — please ensure the DocuSign SOW uses the paying entity "BrightLane US, Inc."

If you can send a sample micro-invoice and the first CSV export before 7/10, procurement can approve the payment schedule and we can start drawdowns 7/15 as proposed.

Best,
Juliette Martin
Head of Procurement
BrightLane Corp
